summary.headline: Astrological Questions by Folio
summary.text: Continuation of a Florentine codex catalogue listing astrological questions and judgments by folio, including beginnings, travel, marriage, health, loans, theft, nativities, eclipses, fixed stars, planetary conjunctions, zodiacal oppositions, and stellar powers.
